{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load and clean data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Group by channel and sum revenue
total_revenue_by_channel = sales_df.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()

# Sort by revenue descending
total_revenue_by_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.sort_values(by='revenue', ascending=False)

# Get the top channel
top_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.iloc[0]

(total_revenue_by_channel, top_channel)"}
